summary: The proposed patch addresses a known issue where `fit_predict` and `predict` can disagree when `n_init > 1`. However, the patch introduces a potential behavioral regression risk by calling `_set_parameters(best_params)` unconditionally, which could affect other parts of the codebase.

issues.description: Calling `_set_parameters(best_params)` unconditionally may introduce behavioral regression risk, affecting other parts of the codebase.
